name: CrossWatch
description: Syncs watch history, watchlists, ratings and playback progress between Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Trakt, SIMKL and more. This build adds a German user interface (switchable in the profile), a one-time setup link and an update button in the web interface.

notes.text: The admin account is created in the browser. Only the one-time setup link shown at the end of the installation can do that; it is also in `/config/.setup_token` and in `journalctl -u crosswatch`.
Update with `update` in the container console or with the update notice in the web interface (bell icon). The previous version is restored automatically if the new one does not start.
